defects.description: Description: "Rest one cheek gently against the back of the hand or fingertips" (one hand at face) + "Keep the OTHER arm wrapped loosely around the shins" (other hand at shins). Currently both arms swing BEHIND (shoulderFwd=+30 per corrected convention + = behind). With body reclined (globalTilt=-58), "behind body" maps to UP in world, but wrists at y=-0.036/-0.080 (below hip) — neither at face level (y=0.186) nor shin level (y=0.32).
shoulderFwdL/R=+30 (small back swing). For reclined body, need much larger magnitude to bring hands UP to face/shin level.

regression_risk: high — dramatic joint values (Lsh=-90, Lsf=-120, Lel=140, Rsh=90, Rsf=90) driven by rig limitations. Re-render verify REQUIRED.
rationale: L arm = cheek rest: leftShoulder 65 → -90 (arm raised 90° up), shoulderFwdL 30 → -120 (strong FORWARD swing per - = forward; with globalTilt=-58 "forward body" maps to "down-forward world", bringing wrist UP toward face via deep elbow bend), leftElbow 100 → 140 (very deep bend, hand drops to face level). Result: wristL=(-0.093, 0.234, -0.930), wristL_to_head=0.084m (hand at cheek level). R arm = shin wrap: rightShoulder 55 → 90 (arm abducted 90° out), shoulderFwdR 30 → 90 (strong BEHIND swing per + = behind; with globalTilt=-58 "behind body" maps to "up in world", bringing wrist UP to shin level), rightElbow=100 preserved. Result: wristR=(-0.006, 0.369, -0.197), distance to mid-shin (0.077, 0.346, -0.160) = 0.094m (hand at shin level). Rig-limited: dramatic joint values needed because renderer elbow only rotY; forearm cannot bend horizontally to head/shin from reclined base.
